zh.title: 用 OpenUI 在 Loop 中实现 ChatGPT 式 Intelligent UI

zh.author: Di

en.title: Building ChatGPT-style Intelligent UI in Loop with OpenUI
en.summary: Ten browser-tested scenarios explain Loop’s OpenUI integration, from charts and forms to routes, illustrated guides, timers, scaling, image search, sales, and drums.
en.author: Di
